title: Lettera2FHIR extraction output
description: Structured data extracted from one Italian discharge letter. Every item must include an evidence quote copied verbatim from the letter.

evidence.description: Exact substring of the letter supporting this item, copied character by character (same spelling, punctuation and abbreviations). Shortest span that is still unambiguous.

text.description: Diagnosis or problem as written in the letter.

role.description: principale/secondaria: discharge diagnoses (FHIR category encounter-diagnosis). anamnestica: past or chronic conditions from the history (FHIR category problem-list-item).

clinical_status.description: FHIR Condition.clinicalStatus. Use unknown when the letter does not say.

verification_status.description: FHIR Condition.verificationStatus. provisional for 'sospetta', 'probabile', 'da verificare'. refuted for explicit exclusions such as 'si esclude'.

medication.description: Maps to FHIR MedicationStatement. If the same drug appears in different contexts (e.g. home therapy and discharge therapy), create one item per context.

name.description: Drug name as written: brand name or active ingredient.

dose.description: Dose as written, e.g. '100 mg', '1 cp', '20 UI'. null if absent.

frequency.description: Frequency as written, e.g. '1 cp/die', 'x 2/die', 'al bisogno'. null if absent.

route.description: Route of administration if stated or unambiguous from the formulation (e.g. 'cp' implies orale). null otherwise.

status.description: FHIR R4 MedicationStatement.status. stopped for suspended therapies, intended for therapies to start after discharge.

context.description: Which part of the care pathway the mention refers to.

observation.description: Maps to FHIR Observation (laboratory results only, no vital signs or imaging).

value_numeric.description: Numeric value with a dot as decimal separator (the letter may use a comma). null for non-numeric results.

value_text.description: Non-numeric result, e.g. 'negativo', 'nella norma'. null when value_numeric is set.

unit.description: Unit as written, e.g. 'g/dl', 'mg/L'. null if absent.

timing.description: When the test was taken, if stated.

interpretation.description: Only if the letter states it explicitly (e.g. 'aumentata', 'nei limiti'). Do not infer from reference ranges. Maps to FHIR interpretation H/L/N.
